LESSON: PRECAUTIONS WHEN USING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and 1.7 Energy: Light By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners t
Topic 1.7.3: Precautions when using

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Precautions when using. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: which light the eyes (reading in dim light, harm us?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Precautions when using
2. Practise Precautions when using at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Precautions when using

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Precautions when using
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Precautions when using. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Precautions when using at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Precautions when using at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Precautions when using
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Precautions when using. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Precautions when using using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Precautions when using in the examples.
2. Explain Precautions when using to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Precautions when using.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Precautions when using using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Precautions when using important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, learners discuss safety harmful light when using light energy. precautions in protecting self and energy? others from harmful light energy
2. Learners create messages on awareness of harmful effects of light energy

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which light the eyes (reading in dim light, harm us?
2. when using light energy. precautions in protecting self and energy?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Precautions when using
2. Practise Precautions when using at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Precautions when using

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
